liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): The opener is played at a breakneck tempo, which the reviewer finds funny [13]
- **Big River** (1 review): Jerry plays a great double-time section, which this reviewer rates the best version of the song they had seen [14]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): One listener heard Jerry's lyric delivery as a comment on Reagan's reelection; another reviewer disputes this [17]
- **I Ain't Superstitious** (1 review): The drummers have trouble settling on the right beat and never lock in [13]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 other source): The song is retitled One More Halloween Night for the occasion [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **I Ain't Superstitious**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 9 archived performances [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-10-31.142422.sbd.miller.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1984-10-31.175947.marantz.superscope.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 155 min [3]
- **gd1984-10-31.169041.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.new.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 151 min [5]
- **gd84-10-31.senn.14947.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 143 min; rated 2.45/5 by 11 [11]. Said about its sound: This audience copy has no Drums segment [13]
- **gd1984-10-31.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.106798.flac16**: soundboard; 1 songs; 15 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [12]. Said about its sound: This soundboard upload is a single track, leaving the rest of the show unaccounted for [20]

## Around the show

- Matt Kelly found a spot in the band's sound and seemed comfortable that night [14]
- Matt Kelly plays harmonica with the band on the asterisked tracks, and the band has a Halloween feel [23]
- Matt Kelly joins on Minglewood, Big Railroad, Miracle, Superstitious and Around & Around [1]
- Matthew Kelly plays harmonica on Minglewood > Big Railroad, Lazy Lightning, Miracle > Superstitious and Around & Around [3]
- Matthew Kelly plays harmonica on Minglewood, Big Railroad, Miracle, Superstitious and Around & Around [5]
- Asterisked songs (Minglewood, Big Railroad, Miracle, Superstitious, Around & Around) feature Matt Kelly [11]
- The reviewer thinks this show is underrated because the next two shows in the run had rarer songs [14]
- The reviewer finds this show less tight than the 28th and 30th [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-10-31.142422.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master > Reel (Technics) > Dat (Panasonic SV-3800/48k) [1]. Also: Source is DATs from Rob Eaton, with pitch correction settings from Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd1984-10-31.175947.marantz.superscope.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Terry; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Mark Terry's Master Audience Cassettes; Beyer Dynamics M300 mics > Sony WM-D6C (Maxell XLII-S90) [3]. Also: Master cassette from Mark Terry, transferred by Charlie Miller; Bob Menke's Nakamichi 700 source patches the Minglewood transition and Space [3]
- **gd1984-10-31.169041.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.new.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > ?? > Jim Vita's cassettes (Maxell XLII-S) [5]. Also: Jim Vita's cassette source, transferred by Charlie Miller; patches come from Doug Lamarre's Sennheiser 441 (He's Gone) and Bob Menke's Nakamichi 700 (Drums) [5]
- **gd84-10-31.senn.14947.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD (Sennheiser 441) > CM > CDR > WAV > SHN. Thanks to Dr. B.Fried for the cassette masters. [11]. Also: This is a re-seed of an earlier seed by C Ladner [11]
- **gd1984-10-31.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.106798.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master [12]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-10-30 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-10-30-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca-usa/) [26]
